explication: faster-whisper is a Python Whisper transcription runtime backed by CTranslate2. An application supplies audio and configures WhisperModel, which loads a converted model, decodes and optionally filters audio, extracts log-Mel features, runs Whisper inference, and yields timestamped transcription segments. Tokenization supports multilingual transcription/translation, while optional batching and word-level alignment enrich results. The graph emphasizes runtime control flow; several internal calls are inferred from documented behavior and sampled excerpts, while unsampled implementation details are intentionally omitted.
